dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Well, I wanted to go on adventures all over the world at the helm of a large ship, sailing freely wherever I pleased. That's why I became a helmsman.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Now that I'm the helmsman of the Alcor, half my dream has been realized. The other half may never be fulfilled, though, which is a shame.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Though I'm the helmsman, where we're headed, what route we're taking... I still need to take orders from the Captain and our navigator on those matters.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Honestly, it was a bit disappointing at first, but I think I got over it as time went by.

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: Most people's lives are like that, anyway. Those who can control their own path will always be few and far between...

dialogues.speaker: Sea Drake
dialogues.text: I mean, at least I've met a leader who I can fully trust, you know? Captain Beidou will never lead us wrong.
